correctness.rationale: The Rule-184 local map f(a,b,c)=(1-b)a+bc conserves particle count on cyclic words. A 16-state paired de Bruijn matrix T(z) enforces equality of two outputs at each site; closed walks correspond bijectively to ordered input pairs with weight z^{|x|}. Independent exact SymPy reconstruction confirmed det(tI-T)=t^10(t²+z)(t⁴-(1+z)t³-z t²+z(z+1)t-2z²). Hence the formal log determinant identity proves all-length ∑C_n(z)u^n=-u∂_u log D(u,z). At z=1 the largest simple eigenvalue λ=1/2+sqrt(5/4+sqrt3) uniquely dominates, yielding C_n(1)~λ^n. Independently verified the proposed 12-state principal directed component has strictly positive adjacency sixth power, and unit-weight and z-weight loops break all nonzero-frequency phase periodicity. Implicit differentiation of the quartic gives density mean 1/2, variance σ²=(λ²−1)/(4(2λ−1)(λ²−λ−1))>0; ordinary analytic Perron saddle yields C_{n,n/2}~λ^n/sqrt(2πnσ²), and Stirling on binomial(n,n/2)^2 produces sqrt(πn/(8σ²))(λ/4)^n. Independent direct output-fiber enumeration for n=3,...,9 matched palindromic coefficients: C_4=[1,4,18,4,1], C_6=[1,6,27,56,27,6,1], C_8=[1,8,44,136,234,136,44,8,1]. Finite tests do not prove asymptotics.
